business_summary: Shanghai Fengyuzhu Culture Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research and development of digital new media technologies in China. It is also involved in production, distribution, and management of digital content. In addition, the company various provides, such as digital cultural and creative content application, digital technology, digital creative product exhibition and display, literary and artistic creation, conference and exhibition, project planning and public relations, information consulting and system integration, market and marketing planning, artificial intelligence industry application system integration, data processing, photography and video production, and engineering management services, as well as technical services, technical development, technical consultation, technical exchange, technology transfer, and technology promotion services. Further, it engages in digital cultural and creative software development; sales of digital cultural and creative technology equipment; organizing cultural and artistic exchange activities; entertainment exhibitions; animation and game development; advertising design and agency; advertising production: digital advertising design and agency; scenic area management; leisure and sightseeing activities; sales of arts and crafts and etiquette items, building decoration materials, metal fittings for construction, mechanical and electrical equipment, technical glass products, metal matrix composites and ceramic matrix composites, and basic materials for 3D printing; and manufacturing of computer hardware and software and peripheral equipment, audio equipment, network equipment, internet equipment, and amusement equipment. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Fengyuzhu Exhibition Co., Ltd. Shanghai Fengyuzhu Culture Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Shanghai, China.
